_doc: Boarding Combat (2d6, 1997 chart p.109). rows: modified 2d6 DR ('4' = <=4 ... '12' = >=12) -> pct = enemy loses this % of the ROLLER's TBCF (fractions round to the nearest whole BCF); attacker = special result when rolled by the attacker ('none', 'capture_if_lt_mr' = roll d10, if DR < defender's MR the defending ship is captured, 'capture'); defender = special result when rolled by the defender ('none', 'repulse_if_lt_mr' = roll d10, if DR < attacker's MR the attacker is repulsed, 'repulse_mc1' / 'repulse_mc2' = attacker repulsed and takes 1 / 2 MC). odds_drm: TBCF odds DRMs (F:E, applies to both sides) as [num, den, drm] from 1:4 up to 4:1; a ratio is rounded down to the next lower listed ratio, below 1:4 is -4, and 1:1 = 0 (left off the printed chart). class_drm: Other DRMs (attacker only): defending ship class 1/2/3, plus per_class_larger per class the defender is larger (lower class #), per_class_smaller per class it is smaller. prize_minimum: prize crew minimum boxes by the prize's class (10.G.7).
